mentions.name: totally normal keyboard
mentions.description: A keyboard hack/firmware project that turns the keyboard itself into a multi-tool, with a built-in clipboard manager, password vault, and barcode reader. It currently goes by the working name "totally normal keyboard", and the author is looking for a better name.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m currently hacking away at a project which turns your keyboard into a clipboard manager, password vault and barcode reader as parts of it. I just need to come up with a better name than totally normal keyboard (:
